name: 多 Key 轮换池
author: NethielChou
description: 把 DSH 里已配置的供应商/模型手动加入轮换池：额度用完自动按顺序切到下一条，可跨供应商跨模型；侧边栏面板支持勾选、排序，并显示当前路由、冷却与最近切换记录。
descriptionEn: Manually add your configured provider/model routes to a failover pool. When a route runs out of quota the next healthy one is used in the same turn, across providers and models. A sidebar panel lets you pick, order, and watch the live route, cooling providers, and recent switches.
